related.title: 阿里安六號共乘酬載分離
related.transfer: 沿運載器、分離介面與衛星接管對照邊界。
related.transferEn: Compare boundaries across launch vehicle, separation interface, and spacecraft takeover.
related.why: 兩課都要求可複查的質量收支及離線事件表；請先找到證據格式的共通欄位。
related.whyEn: Both courses require a reviewable mass budget and offline event ledger. First find the evidence fields they share.
related.difference: 以動量守恆求分離後的相對速度與兩端反沖。
related.differenceEn: Use conservation of momentum to estimate relative release velocity and recoil.
practice: 各選一個名義結果，保留輸入與來源。
對照介面、失效條件與資料解析度。
把一項驗證改編到另一案例，記下不可沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Select one nominal result in each case, retaining inputs and sources.
Compare interfaces, failure conditions, and data resolution.
Transfer a verification to the other case and document assumptions that do not carry across.
